products.name: LED Bulb Housing — A67 mm
products.description: Two-part LED bulb housing — body and diffuser — 67 mm diameter, 130 mm height.
products.overview: A two-part moulded LED bulb housing made up of the body and the diffuser. The body is moulded in glass-filled PBT for strength and heat resistance, and the diffuser in PC for even light spread. Supplied as a blank moulded housing, ready for the customer's LED module and driver.

products.name: LED Bulb Housing Range — A Series
products.description: Housings, diffusers, cups and plates for A-55 to A-95 mm LED bulbs.
products.overview: A complete range of LED bulb housing parts in A-series sizes from 55 mm to 95 mm, including HB and LB variants. Each size is available as a set of housing, diffuser, cup and, where required, plate. Every part is checked for outer diameter, inner diameter, height, neck diameter and weight using digital vernier calipers and weighing scales.

specs.label: Inspection
specs.value: Digital vernier caliper, weighing scale, micrometer

parts: A-57 LB housing / diffuser / cup / plate
A-65 HB & LB housing / diffuser / cup / plate

products.name: High-Wattage Bulb Housing — H Series
products.description: Housings, diffusers and cups for H-80 to H-140 mm high-wattage LED bulbs.
products.overview: Larger housing sets for high-wattage LED bulbs in H-series sizes from 80 mm to 140 mm. Each size has a finned housing for heat dissipation, a matching diffuser and a metal cup, all inspected for dimensions and weight before dispatch.

specs.label: Inspection
specs.value: Digital vernier caliper, weighing scale, micrometer

products.name: AC/DC Bulb Housing
products.description: Housing, diffuser, ring and plate set for AC/DC (rechargeable) LED bulbs.
products.overview: A housing set for AC/DC LED bulbs consisting of the housing, diffuser, ring and plate. Parts are moulded to close tolerances so that the assembly fits without gaps.

products.name: Concealed Light Housing
products.description: Round PC housing for concealed downlights — 110 mm outer diameter, 70 mm cut-out.
products.overview: A round concealed light housing moulded in high-strength polycarbonate with a matte white finish. Designed to take LED modules and COBs, with a smooth front ring for a clean ceiling finish.
products.readyCaption: Finished product shown for reference — JURO manufactures the housing and components; assembly is done by our customers.

products.name: Spot Light Housing — 2W
products.description: Compact PC housing for 2W LED spot lights — 42 mm outer diameter, 32.4 mm cut-out.
products.overview: A compact white polycarbonate housing for 2W LED spot lights, with spring clips for recessed mounting. Used for accent and decorative lighting in homes, offices, retail stores and showrooms.
products.readyCaption: Finished product shown for reference — JURO manufactures the housing and components; assembly is done by our customers.

products.name: Panel Mounting Clip
products.description: Nickel-plated spring clip for mounting 1×1 and 2×2 LED panels.
products.overview: A spring-type mounting clip for recessed LED panels and fixtures. Made from MS with a nickel-plated silver finish and a high-tension coil spring for a firm hold across different ceiling thicknesses.

products.name: Extension Board Housings
products.description: Moulded multi-socket extension board housings in five designs.
products.overview: Front and back housings for multi-socket extension boards, available in five designs: a long strip with USB openings, a round 4-socket strip with indicator, a block type, a compact triangle with handle and a compact cube. Back covers include screw slots for wall mounting.

specs.label: Designs
specs.value: Strip (3-socket), round strip (4-socket), block, triangle, cube

specs.label: Mounting
specs.value: Wall-mount screw slots on back cover

products.name: 16A Socket-with-Switch Box Housing
products.description: Polycarbonate combined box housing for a 16A socket with switch.
products.overview: A flush-mounting combined box housing for a 16A 3-pin socket with a one-way switch. Moulded in polycarbonate with a premium glossy white finish, for residential and commercial use.

categories.title: Lighting Housings & Components
categories.summary: Moulded housings, diffusers, cups, rings and clips for LED bulbs, downlights and panels.
categories.seoDescription: LED bulb housings (A-series, H-series, AC/DC), concealed light housings, spot light housings and panel mounting clips manufactured by Jugnu Roshni Pvt. Ltd. (JURO), Ghaziabad.
categories.description:
We manufacture housings and components for the lighting industry: LED bulb housings with matching diffusers, cups, rings and plates, concealed and spot light housings, and spring-type panel mounting clips. Parts are produced to the customer's drawing and inspected for outer diameter, inner diameter, height, neck diameter and weight before dispatch.

We supply the housing and components; our customers assemble the electronics and finished light.

categories.title: Electrical Accessory Housings

categories.description: We manufacture moulded housings for electrical accessories, including multi-socket extension board housings in several designs and 16A socket-with-switch combined box housings. Housings are made to the customer's design and supplied for assembly into the finished product.
